blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: We introduce P$^{3}$-WAM, a unified world action model for egocentric dexterous manipulation that learns 3D perception, action-conditioned prediction, and goal-directed planning through three complementary modes: Perceive, which reconstructs articulated hand motion and camera trajectories from video; Predict, which generates visual futures under prescribed actions; and Plan, which jointly generates action trajectories and their anticipated visual consequences conditioned on an initial image, a language instruction, and an optional visual goal. Our model integrates a compact, structured 3D action representation into a pretrained video diffusion transformer through a mixture-of-transformers architecture with shared base weights, modality-specific adaptation, and bidirectional visual-action attention. Randomized modality visibility lets video and 3D actions serve as either conditioning context or prediction targets across the three modes. Experiments show that unified training improves all three capabilities over single-mode training, including gains in planning quality under a vision-language model evaluation. Through unified training, our model outperforms specialized baselines on 3D hand reconstruction and action-conditioned video prediction across four datasets, while producing goal-directed manipulation videos with stronger instruction adherence and action progression than video-generation baselines. Project Page: https://p3-wam.pages.dev/
blocks.zh: 我们引入了P$3}$-WAM, 一种以自负为核心的自负式操纵的统一世界行动模式,通过三种互补模式学习了3D感知,行动有条件的预测,以及目标导向规划: 视觉,它从视频中重建清晰的手动和相机轨迹; 预测,它根据规定的动作产生视觉未来; 计划,它联合生成动作轨迹及其预期的视觉后果,以初始图像,语言指示,以及可选的视觉目标为条件. 我们的模型将一个紧凑,结构分明的3D动作表现器通过一个具有共享基重,模式特异性改造,双向可视化动作注意的转换器,整合到一个经过预先训练的视频传播变压器中. 随机模式的能见度让视频和3D动作成为三种模式的上下文或预测目标。 实验显示,统一培训比单一模式培训提高所有三种能力,包括在愿景语言模式评价下规划质量方面的进步。 通过统一培训,我们的模型在三维手部重建和行动条件视频预测方面超越了专门的基线,在四个数据集中,同时制作目标导向的操纵视频,比视频生成基线更能遵守指令和行动进展。 项目网页:https://p3-wam.pages.dev/

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Dexterous manipulation requires more than mapping pixels directly to actions. An embodied model must answer three complementary questions: What happened in an observed interaction? What will happen under a specified action? What should be done to accomplish a desired goal? These questions correspond to three fundamental capabilities: perceiving the 3D motion underlying observed interactions, predicting action-conditioned world dynamics, and planning actions together with their anticipated consequences. Infants can use what they learn from observing adults’ actions to guide their own behavior ( Hauf & Aschersleben, 2008 ) . Through their own interactions, they learn to predict action outcomes and use those expected outcomes to select actions ( Verschoor et al., 2013 ) and organize movements toward a goal ( Claxton et al., 2003 ) . Together, these findings suggest that perception, prediction, and planning are linked by knowledge of actions and their consequences.
blocks.zh: Dexterous操控需要的不仅仅是直接将像素映射到动作上. 一个体现的模式必须回答三个相辅相成的问题: 观察到的相互作用中发生了什么? 在特定行动下会发生什么情况? 为实现所期望的目标应当做些什么? 这些问题对应三个基本能力:了解观察到的相互作用背后的3D运动,预测有行动条件的世界动态,规划行动及其预期后果。 婴儿可以通过观察成年人的行为来指导自己的行为(Hauf & Aschersleben,2008年)。 他们通过自己的互动,学会预测行动结果并利用这些预期成果来选择行动(Verschoor等,2013年)并组织朝向目标的运动(Claxton等,2003年)。 这些调查结果共同表明,认识、预测和规划是通过对行动及其后果的了解联系在一起的。

blocks.en: Despite these connections, prior work on egocentric manipulation has developed along three closely related but largely separate lines. Egocentric reconstruction methods recover structured 3D interaction information, such as hand motion and camera trajectories, from observed videos ( Pavlakos et al., 2024 ; Yu et al., 2025 ) . Action-conditioned world models predict future observations under prescribed motion trajectories ( Hao et al., 2026 ; Wang et al., 2026b ; Sun et al., 2026 ) . World action models jointly generate actions and future observations for goal-directed control ( Ye et al., 2026 ) . These capabilities, however, are still largely learned in isolation or coupled only in subsets.
blocks.zh: 尽管存在这些联系,以前关于以自我为中心的操纵的工作仍然沿着三个密切相关但基本上独立的线发展。 Egocentral重建方法从被观测到的视频中恢复结构化的3D相互作用信息,如手动和相机轨迹(Pavlakos等,2024;Yu等,2025.). 行动条件世界模型预测未来在规定的运动轨迹下观测(Hao等,2026;Wang等,2026b;Sun等,2026.). 世界行动模式共同产生针对目标控制的行动和未来观测结果(Ye等人,2026年)。 然而,这些能力在很大程度上仍然是孤立地学习的,或者只在子集中学习。

blocks.en: To close this loop, we introduce P 3 -WAM, a unified world action model for egocentric dexterous manipulation that integrates three complementary modes: 3D interaction reconstruction ( Perceive ), action-conditioned world prediction ( Predict ), and joint action–future planning ( Plan ). Reconstruction develops the model’s capacity for 3D perception by recovering 3D motion from observed interactions. Prediction teaches the model to anticipate the visual consequences of prescribed actions. Together, these capabilities provide the foundation for world–action planning, in which the model learns to jointly generate goal-directed hand action trajectories and their anticipated visual futures. We learn all three modes through unified training. Figure 1 illustrates these three modes.
blocks.zh: 为了关闭这一循环,我们引入了P 3 - WAM, 一种以自负为核心的自负操纵的统一世界行动模式,它融合了三种互补模式:3D互动重建(透视),行动条件世界预测(预测)和联合行动未来规划(计划). 重建通过从所观察到的相互作用中恢复3D运动来发展模型的3D感知能力. 预测教该模型预测规定行动的视觉后果。 这些能力共同为世界-行动规划提供了基础,在该规划中,模型学习共同产生目标导向的手动作轨迹及其预期的视觉未来. 我们通过统一培训学习所有三种模式。 图1说明了这三种模式。

blocks.en: We build P 3 -WAM on a pretrained video diffusion transformer ( Wan et al., 2025 ) to draw on its rich visual and motion priors. We represent each action by the articulated poses of both hands and the camera pose, and encode these states as compact tokens alongside the video tokens. We integrate this representation into the video backbone through a mixture-of-transformers (MoT) architecture with a dedicated action expert, which shares the backbone’s base weights while incorporating modality-specific low-rank adaptation (LoRA) ( Hu et al., 2022 ) . To train this architecture across all three modes, we randomly vary the visibility of visual observations and actions: providing video while withholding actions supports perception, providing actions while withholding future video supports prediction, and withholding actions and video supports joint action–future planning, exposing the model to complete modes and partially observed interactions. Over long sequences, successive visual subgoals specify the target arrangement for each planning window.
blocks.zh: 我们用一个经过预先训练的视频传播变压器(Wan等人,2025年)建造了P 3-WAM,以利用它丰富的视觉和运动前身。 我们用双手和相机的姿势来代表每一个行动,并将这些状态编码为紧凑的标志和视频标志。 我们通过一个具有专门行动专家的转换器(MoT)结构,将这种代表纳入视频主干,该结构分享主干的基准权重,同时纳入特定模式的低级适应(LORA)(Hu等,2022年)。 为了在三种模式中训练这种架构,我们随机地改变视觉观察和动作的能见度:提供视频的同时扣取动作支持知觉,提供动作同时扣取未来视频支持预测,并扣取动作和视频支持联合行动 — — 未来规划,将模型曝光以完成模式和部分被观察的互动. 在漫长的序列中,相继的视觉分目标为每个规划窗口规定了目标安排.

blocks.en: Unified training improves all three modes over single-mode training. Our model outperforms the evaluated baselines in Perceive and Predict . Its Plan videos receive higher VLM scores for action process and instruction adherence. Robot demonstrations illustrate how generated human-hand motion can be transferred to a dexterous robot. Our main contributions are:
blocks.zh: 统一培训比单一模式培训改进所有三种模式。 我们的模型的效绩超过了所评估的基线。 其计划视频获得较高的VLM分数,用于行动过程和遵守指令. 机器人演示说明产生的人手运动如何能被转移给有德性能的机器人. 我们的主要贡献是:

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: Action-conditioned world models predict single images ( Sudhakar et al., 2024 ) or roll out videos ( Akkerman et al., 2025 ; DreamX Team et al., 2026 ; Gao et al., 2026a ) . Wan ( Wan et al., 2025 ) and Cosmos 3 ( NVIDIA, 2026 ) provide pretrained video priors. For action representation, Dexterous World Models ( Kim et al., 2026 ) uses rendered scenes and hand-mesh trajectories, while DreamDojo ( Gao et al., 2026b ) learns latent actions from human videos for robot-world rollouts. Explicit scene and camera geometry can also help maintain spatial consistency. EgoSim ( Hao et al., 2026 ) combines video generation with an updatable 3D scene and shared human–robot keypoints, and EgoGenesis ( Yan et al., 2026b ) uses camera-aware 3D action embeddings and online projective memory for autoregressive rollout.
blocks.zh: 有行动条件的世界模型预测单一图像(Sudhakar等,2024年)或推出视频(Akkerman等,2025年;DreamX) Team等,2026;Gao等,2026a.). Wan(Wan等,2025年)和Cosmos 3(NVIDIA,2026年)提供经过事先训练的视频前传. Dexterous World Models(Kim等, 2026年)使用场景和手绘轨迹, 清晰的场景和相机几何也可有助于保持空间一致性. EgoSim (Hao等,2026年)将视频生成与可提升的3D场景并共享人-robot键位结合,而EgoGenesis (Yan等,2026b)则使用相机-知相机3D动作嵌入和在线投影内存来进行自回式推出.

blocks.en: World action models generate actions alongside anticipated visual dynamics through causal video prediction and inverse dynamics, as in LingBot-VA ( Li et al., 2026a ) , or joint video–action flow matching, as in DreamZero ( Ye et al., 2026 ) . Fast-WAM ( Yuan et al., 2026 ) , Foresight Without Seeing ( Huang et al., 2026 ) , and RIFT ( Zhang et al., 2026 ) study predictive visual information for control without a complete iterative visual rollout at deployment.
blocks.zh: 世界行动模型通过因果视频预测和反向动态产生与预期视觉动态同步的行动,如LingBot-VA(Li等,2026a),或联合视频-动作流匹配,如DreamZero(Ye等,2026). 快速WAM( 快速WAM ) (袁克等,2026年),"不见不见"(黄克等,2026年),RIFT(张克等,2026年)研究预测视觉信息进行控制,部署时没有完全迭代视觉展开.

blocks.en: Recovering 3D hand motion from video requires estimating hand articulation while accounting for a moving camera. Single-image methods provide hand pose and shape estimates: HaMeR ( Pavlakos et al., 2024 ) scales transformer capacity and heterogeneous training data, while WiLoR ( Potamias et al., 2025 ) integrates localization, handedness estimation, and image-aligned mesh refinement. For egocentric sequences, HaWoR ( Zhang et al., 2025 ) and Dyn-HaMR ( Yu et al., 2025 ) combine hand-motion estimation with SLAM to recover global trajectories, using temporal infilling or interacting-hand priors and optimization. Concurrent work MINT ( Zhu et al., 2026 ) jointly estimates camera and hand motion.
blocks.zh: 从视频中取回3D手动需要估算手相,同时计算出移动相机. 单一图像方法提供手姿势和形状估计: HaMeR (Pavlakos等, 2024年) 缩放变压器容量和多变的训练数据,而WiLOR (Potamias等, 2025年) 整合了本地化,相接性估计和图像相通的网格改进. 对于以自负为中心的序列,HaWOR(张等,2025年)和Dyn-HAMR(Yu等,2025年)将手动估计与SLAM结合来恢复全球轨迹,使用时间填充或交互手前和优化. 同时期工作MINT(Zhu等,2026年)联合估计相机和手动.

blocks.en: Video generative models offer another source of information about hand motion. Concurrent works ViDiHand ( Wang et al., 2026a ) and ACE-Ego-Hand ( Liu et al., 2026 ) use video diffusion features for hand motion recovery. We train reconstruction jointly with future prediction and planning, allowing the model to learn from how hand interactions unfold as well as from observed video. This joint training improves 3D hand reconstruction in our single-mode comparison (Sec. 4.1 ).
blocks.zh: 视频基因模型为手动提供了又一信息来源. 同时期作品"ViDiHand"(Wang等,2026a)和"ACE-Ego-Hand"(Liu等,2026)使用视频传播功能进行手动恢复. 我们结合未来的预测和规划来训练重建,使模型能够从手动互动如何进行以及从所观察到的视频中学习. 这种联合培训改进了我们单模式比较中的3D手部重建(第4.1节)。

blocks.en: A shared model can connect these tasks by changing which modalities are observed and which are generated. Unified World Models ( Zhu et al., 2025a ) couples video and action diffusion for forward, inverse, policy, and video inference. Language provides a further interface for world modeling and control: Motus ( Bi et al., 2026 ) combines language, video, and latent actions, while MotuBrain ( MotuBrain Team et al., 2026 ) jointly models text, video, and embodiment-specific actions. Geometric modalities extend this shared formulation to spatial reasoning. Flex- π \pi ( Yan et al., 2026a ) includes pointmap and feature streams alongside RGB and actions, and Aether ( Zhu et al., 2025b ) unifies 4D reconstruction, camera-conditioned prediction, and goal-image-conditioned visual planning. P 3 -WAM applies joint reconstruction, prediction, and planning to articulated hand interaction. It plans hand and camera trajectories together with video and supports visual goals to preserve spatial targets across a task.
blocks.zh: 共同模式可以通过改变所观察到的模式和产生的方式将这些任务联系起来。 统一世界模式 (Zhu等人,2025a)夫妇视频和行动传播,用于前向,倒向,政策和视频推论. 语言为世界建模和控制提供了又一界面: Motus(Bi等,2026年)结合了语言,视频,和潜伏动作,而MotuBrain(MotuBrain Team等,2026年)联合了文本,视频,和特指动作. 几何模式将这种共享的提法扩展到了空间推理. Flex-π\pi(Yan等,2026a)包括点图和特征流与RGB和行动,而Aether(Zhu等,2025b)统一了4D重建,相机条件的预测,以及目标条件的视觉规划. P 3 - WAM应用联合重建,预测和规划来表达手动互动. 它将手和相机轨迹与视频一起规划,并支持可视目标,以在整个任务中保持空间目标.

blocks.en: We build the model on top of the pretrained Wan2.2-Fun-A14B-Control model ( Alibaba PAI, 2025 ) . We retain its latent video representation, text and first-frame conditioning, skeleton-based control pathway, and high- and low-noise diffusion experts as the RGB generation backbone.
blocks.zh: 我们在预先训练的Wan2.2-Fun-A14B控制模型(Alibaba PAI, 2025年)上建造模型。 我们保留其潜在的视频表现、文本和第一帧配置、基于骨架的控制路径,以及高噪音和低噪音传播专家作为RGB生成的主干。

blocks.en: Observed actions enter through two complementary paths: rendered hand skeletons and camera-ray maps provide spatially aligned controls for hand placement and viewpoint, while compact action tokens carry the corresponding states into joint attention.
blocks.zh: 被观测到的行动通过两个互补路径进入:使手骨架和相机射线图为手放和视线提供空间一致的控制,而紧凑的动作符将相应的状态带入了共同的注意力.

blocks.en: Specifically, the RGB sequence is encoded into a spatiotemporal latent using the Wan2.1 VAE ( Wan et al., 2025 ) . The temporally aligned hand trajectory is rendered as a 2D skeleton video and encoded by the same VAE (Fig. 3 ). The resulting control latent is concatenated with the noisy RGB latent before DiT patch embedding. For camera conditioning, we express all camera-to-world poses in the first camera coordinate frame, making the first pose the identity, and construct per-pixel Plücker ray maps ( Plücker, 1865 ) from the relative poses and camera intrinsics. After temporal packing to the video-latent frame rate, a lightweight convolutional adapter maps the Plücker representation into the DiT patch-feature space. Its output is then added to the joint RGB–hand patch embeddings. The same conditioning interfaces are used by both diffusion experts.

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion

blocks.en:
We introduced P 3 -WAM, a unified world action model for
egocentric dexterous manipulation that integrates perception,
prediction, and planning. A coupled video–action transformer
connects visual generation with explicit hand and camera
trajectories and supports all three modes within the same model. Through extensive experiments, we show that unified training benefits hand reconstruction, action-conditioned video
prediction, and planning.

blocks.en: Limitations. Estimating the global 3D hand position from monocular video is inherently ambiguous. Incorporating tactile or depth sensing could provide stronger geometric constraints. Our robot experiments currently rely on open-loop execution. Introducing closed-loop feedback would allow the robot to correct its motion online, potentially improving robustness over longer-horizon interactions.

blocks.en: E.5 Real-world execution evaluation

blocks.en:
In addition to evaluating the generated videos perceptually, we test whether
the predicted manipulation behaviors can be transferred to and executed by
a physical robot. We conduct two real-world experiments in which the
model-generated action sequences are converted into executable robot
trajectories and replayed in the corresponding physical environments.
This evaluation tests whether the generated behavior captures sufficiently
accurate object interactions and action ordering to support downstream
robot execution.

blocks.en:
Starting from a generated manipulation video, we reconstruct the relevant
objects and scene and recover their motion over time. The reconstructed
hand motion is then retargeted to the robot hand to obtain an initial
robot trajectory.
The
resulting action sequence is then deployed on the physical robot without
further modification.

Thus, the complete evaluation pipeline is generated video → \rightarrow scene and object reconstruction → \rightarrow robot retargeting → \rightarrow real-world execution . This follows do-as-I-do Paliwal et al. (2026) evaluation paradigm, in which a visual demonstration is
converted into an executable robot behavior.

转换成可执行的机器人行为.

blocks.en:
For both experiments, we report whether execution reproduces the intended
manipulation process and reaches the specified task outcome. These
real-world trials complement the human and VLM evaluations above: whereas
the perceptual metrics measure whether an action appears correct and
physically plausible in the generated video, real-world execution provides
a direct test of whether the predicted interaction can be grounded into a
physically executable manipulation trajectory.

blocks.en: H.2 Ethical considerations
blocks.zh: H.2 道德考虑

blocks.en:
Egocentric video can reveal bystanders, personal spaces, and daily activities.
Use and sharing of these data should follow the source datasets’ access and
consent terms, with identifying information minimized in released examples.
Generated interaction videos should be labeled as synthetic. Motion generated
from visual goals requires embodiment-specific validation and supervised
execution before use on physical robots.

爱高中心视频可以揭示旁观者,个人空间,以及日常活动.
这些数据的使用和分享应遵循源数据集的存取和
同意条款,在公布的例子中尽量减少识别信息。
所生成的互动视频应被贴上合成标签. 生成的动议
从视觉目标需要具体化的验证和监督
在物理机器人上使用前执行。
